svg.title: Three-step model alignment workflow
svg.desc: Three base frames are arranged left-to-right: Step 1 specifies a value palette with an original model network and reward distribution charts; Step 2 checks feasibility using a MAP reward function, an infeasible cross, and a feasible check; Step 3 aligns the model, showing a transformed network and post-alignment reward distributions. Arrows connect human input to the original model, Step 1 to Step 2, Step 2 back/forward, and Step 2 to Step 3.

g.desc: Inside Step 1, the title spans the top; a palette icon sits above an original model network; below are three reward distribution plots with an ellipsis to the right.

Inside Step 2, the central origin is the MAP reward function label; above it is a purple constraint grid; right of it is a distribution curve; below are infeasible and feasible indicators arranged horizontally.

Inside Step 3, the top contains a model alignment apparatus icon; the middle shows an original network transformed by a thick rightward arrow into a post-aligned network; the bottom contains three post-alignment reward distribution charts.
